verdict.rationale: monday.com ships its own no-code agent builder: you describe a workflow in plain words and set goals and rules (monday-docs-14, monday-docs-13). Agents can be assigned items and act with status updates and follow-ups (monday-docs-11), and they can fire on item creation or assignment (monday-docs-7, monday-docs-15). The deal-scoring example (monday-docs-32) shows AI-driven prioritization logic, so an agent could plausibly triage incoming work, but no evidence documents bug/task triage or prioritization as a capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI triage/prioritization of incoming bugs or tasks, evidence of automatic priority or severity assignment on new items, independent or hands-on corroboration.
